Identity.History: Larger Hylian cities are often full of various Churches that serve as religious and communal gatherings for the local population. In addition to being a welcoming place for Priests to speak of the Goddesses, they often serve as training grounds for future generations of religious preachers and missionaries.
Identity.Tooltip: Religious building that increases the spread of your territory and allows the training of Support units.
